d: From France to Germany to Serbia, young people are taking to the streets and their anger is growing louder. In France, violent protests have left shops looted and buildings damaged, forcing businesses to shut and security forces to prepare for another tense weekend. Students are demanding better schools and billions in emergency funding. In Germany, young activists are preparing demonstrations over everything from the cost of living to inequality and military conscription. And in Serbia, a student-led movement is taking its fight against the political establishment to the ballot box. Will…
